id: \rYou are quite brave for a child. But this will have you running in no time.
en: \rYou are quite brave for a child. But this will have you running in no time.
it: \rSei piuttosto coraggioso per essere un bambino. Ma questo ti farà scappare in un attimo.

id: \rOh, you came here so you could challenge Sabrina?
en: \rOh, you came here so you could challenge Sabrina?

en: \rTM121 contains Shadow Punch. It never misses.
it: \rL'MT121 contiene Pugnodombra. Non manca mai il bersaglio.

id: \rI wish you luck in your travels.
en: \rI wish you luck in your travels.
it: \rTi auguro buona fortuna per il tuo viaggio.
